I wrote `offerte1.csv` in the working folder. I also created `CONDITIONS.md` with the rules from your request, since none existed yet.

```
sku,aantal,excl,btw,incl
A1,2,79.90,16.78,96.68
A2,15,47.12,9.90,57.02
B2,3,37.50,2.25,39.75
TOTAAL,,164.52,28.93,193.45
```

How the lines were calculated:
- **A1** (Bureaulamp, kantoor, 2 × 39.95): no volume discount. VAT 21% on 79.90 = 16.779, rounded to 16.78.
- **A2** (Ordner, kantoor, 15 × 3.49 = 52.35): 10% off because quantity ≥ 10, giving 47.115, rounded half up to 47.12. VAT 21% on 47.12 = 9.8952, rounded to 9.90.
- **B2** (Agenda 2027, boek, 3 × 12.50): no discount. VAT 6% on 37.50 = 2.25.

The VAT is calculated on the rounded excl amount. Totals are the sums of the line values.

I made `offerte2.csv` from `bestelling2.csv` using the same rules as `offerte1.csv`:

```
sku,aantal,excl,btw,incl
B1,12,583.20,34.99,618.19
A3,1,129.00,27.09,156.09
A2,9,31.41,6.60,38.01
TOTAAL,,743.61,68.68,812.29
```

- **B1** (boek, 12 units): 54.00 × 12 = 648.00, less 10% for quantity ≥ 10 = 583.20. VAT at 6% = 34.992, rounded to 34.99.
- **A3** (kantoor, 1 unit): 129.00, no discount. VAT at 21% = 27.09.
- **A2** (kantoor, 9 units): 3.49 × 9 = 31.41. No discount because 9 is below 10. VAT at 21% = 6.5961, rounded to 6.60.
- **Totals**: 743.61 excl, 68.68 btw, 812.29 incl. These add up.

I also added a section for this task to `CONDITIONS.md`, pointing back to the offerte1 rules. The rules have no stated reasons.
